entities.name: 5GMM-DEREGISTERED
entities.description: Main state in 5GMM protocol indicating the UE is deregistered from the network.

entities.name: 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.NO-SUPI
entities.description: Substate of 5GMM-DEREGISTERED where the UE does not have a valid SUPI.

entities.name: Non-3GPP access not applicable
entities.description: Condition indicating that certain substates are not applicable when using non-3GPP access.

entities.name: Valid subscriber data available
entities.description: Condition that valid subscriber data must be available before entering most substates, except for NO-SUPI.

relations.description: Non-3GPP access condition restricts applicability of substates within 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.
Valid subscriber data condition is required before entering most substates of 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.
Valid subscriber data condition is explicitly not required for entering the NO-SUPI substate.
